recommended_schema.principle: One canonical id per real-world thing in a single master registry; every stream, scenario file, map layer and graph node refers to it. Placeholder keys (MMSI-SYN-*, ICAO-SYN-*, id ranges such as 'EQP-1101 to 1104') are replaced by the real keys used in the data, one record each.

node_types.Organization: agencies, companies, utilities, insurers, contractors, ship agents, outlets (key: ORG-*; aliases list; real_or_fictional flag)
node_types.Vessel: key MMSI; props IMO, name, type, flag, operator -> Organization
node_types.Aircraft: key icao24; props callsign, type, operator; includes drones with a remote id
node_types.Facility: hospitals, shelters, terminals/berths, substations, plants, bases, PSAP (key FAC-*; lat/lon; operator)
node_types.Equipment: pumps, generators, RTUs, breakers (key = asset number used in work orders and SCADA asset id)
node_types.Host: IT/OT hosts (key hostname; ip; subnet) and domains
node_types.Sensor: AQS, sondes, gauges, ASOS, buoys (key sensor id; lat/lon)
node_types.SocialAccount: handle; account_type; operated_by -> Character/Organization; coordinated_network flag (internal)
node_types.ResponseUnit: CAD unit ids -> agency Organization, station Facility
node_types.Area: census tract, ZIP, CAD beat, water district, evacuation zone, neighbourhood (hierarchy WITHIN)
node_types.DataStream: one node per delivered file family with time coverage, schema, key columns
node_types.Observation: optional: the specific rows/time windows that evidence an Event (stream, key value, start, end)
node_types.AnswerKeyPath: ordered steps per Thread, each step -> DataStream/Observation/entity
node_types.Alert: EAS/WEA/boil-water notices with EN and ES release times
node_types.Contract: awards and claims that stories and payments both reference

edge_types.OBSERVED_IN: Event -> DataStream (replaces 317 free-text observed_in labels with a controlled list)
edge_types.RECORDS: DataStream -> entity type it is keyed on (e.g. AIS -> Vessel by MMSI)
edge_types.SAME_AS: temporary alias edge while old ids are being retired
edge_types.POSTED_BY / AMPLIFIES: SocialAccount relations for the coordinated network
